dimensions.note: The model holds no credentials and makes no network calls. The Jev key is read by @swamp/typesafe-ai from the typesafe vault, not by this model.
load and reply log at info on entry and on completion with structured properties (tested); reply logs the action and reason. Neither logs the turn text.

load throws on an unreadable turn file before writing (tested). reply inputs are validated by zod; a missing route answer, a missing or failed decide answer, an unsure answer and an incomplete turn are each recorded with a reason and pass, so the workflow fails open (each tested).

30 unit tests: cleaning, hashing, empty and complete turns, cut-offs, the answer cut-off at its edges, every reply reason, live block text for yes and no, shadow passing with wouldAction, elapsedMs, load failure, reply writing one resource, and log order. 25 hook and workflow tests, including that the decide step is guarded and asks the question the decision eval scored.
Each method writes one fixed-name resource as a new version; repeating a run adds a version and changes nothing else.
No external API; Jev is called by the @swamp/typesafe-ai step in the workflow.
load reads the turn file with Deno.readTextFile and holds no handle. The hook, which creates the file, removes it.
Manifest publishes README, LICENSE, the model and the router workflow (not the eval workflows). README has no IPs, hostnames, account ids or personal paths; private visibility.
Plain z.object schemas with enums and iso datetimes; no passthrough.
turn and reply: lifetime 14d, garbageCollection 2000, so a week of shadow turns is kept and then expires.
Not a lifecycle model; two stateless per-turn methods.
Methods change nothing outside swamp data.
load writes turn/turn and reply writes reply/reply; no overlap. Every schema field is written, including complete, wouldAction, answer, yes and answerCutoff (checked field by field).
Reads no stored data; reply gets the route, the decision answer and complete through workflow inputs from steps.*.

Not yet published (swamp extension version gives currentPublished null, nextVersion 2026.10.13.1), so the version stays 2026.10.13.1. Global arguments are unchanged; the new resource fields are additive.
